mapper.select:
SELECT cr.seq AS roomId, CASE WHEN cr.name IS NOT NULL THEN cr.name WHEN cr.category = 0 THEN tp.title WHEN cr.category = 1 THEN partner.nickname ELSE '이름 없는 채팅방' END AS roomName, cr.category, CASE WHEN cr.category = 0 THEN '동행' WHEN cr.category = 1 THEN '개인' END AS displayCategory, partner.nickname AS partnerNickname, partner.partnerProfile AS partnerProfile,
REGEXP_REPLACE(last_log.detail, '<[^>]*>', '') AS lastMessage, last_log.regdate AS regdate, CASE WHEN last_log.regdate IS NULL THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(last_log.regdate, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS roomTime, 0 AS active FROM chattingroom cr INNER JOIN user_chat uc ON cr.seq = uc.seqChattingroom LEFT JOIN travel_post tp ON cr.seqTravelPost = tp.seqTravelPost LEFT JOIN ( SELECT seqChattingroom, detail, regdate FROM ( SELECT cl.seqChattingroom, cl.detail, cl.regdate, cl.seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cl.seqChattingroom ORDER BY cl.regdate DESC, cl.seq DESC ) AS rn FROM chat_log cl ) WHERE rn = 1 ) last_log ON cr.seq = last_log.seqChattingroom
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uc2.seqChattingroom, MAX(m.nickname) AS nickname, MAX(m.pic) AS partnerProfile FROM user_chat uc2 INNER JOIN member m ON uc2.seqMember = m.seqMember WHERE uc2.seqMember != #{seqMember} GROUP BY uc2.seqChattingroom ) partner ON cr.seq = partner.seqChattingroom
WHERE uc.seqMember = #{seqMember} AND uc.isActive = 1
AND cr.category = #{category}
ORDER BY last_log.regdate DESC NULLS LAST, cr.seq DESC

SELECT cl.seq, cl.detail, cl.seqMember, cl.seqChattingroom, cl.regdate, TO_CHAR(cl.regdate, 'HH24:MI') AS messageTime, m.nickname, m.pic AS partnerProfile, f.savedName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_chat WHERE seqChattingroom = cl.seqChattingroom) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_read_status WHERE seqChatLog = cl.seq) - 1 AS unreadCount, CASE WHEN cl.seqMember = #{loginUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mine FROM chat_log cl INNER JOIN member m ON cl.seqMember = m.seqMember LEFT JOIN files f ON cl.seqFile = f.seq WHERE cl.seqChattingroom = #{roomId} ORDER BY cl.seq ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT seqChatLog.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO chat_log ( seq, seqFile, seqMember, seqChattingroom, detail, regdate ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{seqFile, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{seqMember}, #{seqChattingroom}, #{detail}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO chat_log ( seq, seqMember, seqChattingroom, detail, regdate ) VALUES ( seqChatLog.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{roomId}, '사용자가 채팅방을 나갔습니다.', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT r.seq, r.seqMember, r.seqChattingroom, r.seqTravelPost, r.seqLocation, r.title, TO_CHAR(r.detail) AS detail, r.regdate, r.dDay, r.status, TO_CHAR(r.dDay, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dDayDateText, m.nickname AS writerNickname, TO_CHAR(r.regdate, 'MM-DD') AS regdateText, CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN '종료' WHEN r.dDay IS NULL THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) = 0 THEN 'D-DAY' WHEN TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) > 0 THEN 'D-' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ELSE '종료' END AS dDayText, l.placeName, l.address, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.mapProviderId, rf.filePath, rf.fileType FROM routine r INNER JOIN member m ON r.seqMember = m.seqMember LEFT JOIN location l ON r.seqLocation = l.seqLocation LEFT JOIN ( SELECT seqRoutine, filePath, fileType FROM ( SELECT rf.seqRoutine, f.filePath, f.fileType, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rf.seqRoutine ORDER BY rf.seq ASC ) AS rn FROM routine_file rf INNER JOIN files f ON rf.seqFile = f.seq ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rf ON r.seq = rf.seqRoutine WHERE r.seqChattingroom = #{roomId} ORDER BY r.dDay ASC NULLS LAST, r.regdate DESC

SELECT p.seq, p.seqChattingroom, p.seqMember, p.pollTitle, p.pollEnddate, p.polldetail, m.nickname AS writerNickname, TO_CHAR(p.pollEnddate, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS enddateText, CASE WHEN p.pollEnddate < SYSDATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS pollStatusText, CASE WHEN p.pollEnddate < SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pollClosed, NVL(pr.participantCount, 0) AS participantCount FROM poll p INNER JOIN member m ON p.seqMember = m.seqMember LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pc.seqPoll, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.seqMember) AS participantCount FROM poll_content pc LEFT JOIN poll_result pr ON pc.seq = pr.seqPollContent GROUP BY pc.seqPoll ) pr ON p.seq = pr.seqPoll WHERE p.seqChattingroom = #{roomId} ORDER BY p.pollEnddate ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT seqPoll.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO poll ( seq, seqChattingroom, seqMember, pollTitle, pollEnddate, polldetail ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{seqChattingroom}, #{seqMember}, #{pollTitle}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{pollEnddateInput}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), #{polldetail} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.seq, p.seqChattingroom, p.seqMember, p.pollTitle, p.pollEnddate, p.polldetail, m.nickname AS writerNickname, TO_CHAR(p.pollEnddate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS enddateText, CASE WHEN p.pollEnddate < SYSDATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS pollStatusText, CASE WHEN p.pollEnddate < SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pollClosed, NVL(pr.totalParticipantCount, 0) AS totalParticipantCount FROM poll p INNER JOIN member m ON p.seqMember = m.seqMember LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pc.seqPoll, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.seqMember) AS totalParticipantCount FROM poll_content pc LEFT JOIN poll_result pr ON pc.seq = pr.seqPollContent GROUP BY pc.seqPoll ) pr ON p.seq = pr.seqPoll WHERE p.seq = #{pollId}

SELECT pc.seq, pc.seqPoll, pc.pollContent, COUNT(pr.seq) AS voteCount FROM poll_content pc LEFT JOIN poll_result pr ON pc.seq = pr.seqPollContent WHERE pc.seqPoll = #{pollId} GROUP BY pc.seq, pc.seqPoll, pc.pollContent ORDER BY pc.seq ASC

mapper.select: SELECT r.seq, r.seqMember, r.seqChattingroom, r.seqTravelPost, r.seqLocation, r.title, TO_CHAR(r.detail) AS detail, r.regdate, r.dDay, r.status, TO_CHAR(r.dDay, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dDayDateText, m.nickname AS writerNickname, TO_CHAR(r.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regdateText, CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN '종료' WHEN r.dDay IS NULL THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) = 0 THEN 'D-DAY' WHEN TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) > 0 THEN 'D-' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.dDay) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ELSE '종료' END AS dDayText, l.placeName, l.address, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.mapProviderId, rf.filePath, rf.fileType FROM routine r INNER JOIN member m ON r.seqMember = m.seqMember LEFT JOIN location l ON r.seqLocation = l.seqLocation LEFT JOIN ( SELECT seqRoutine, filePath, fileType FROM ( SELECT rf.seqRoutine, f.filePath, f.fileType, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rf.seqRoutine ORDER BY rf.seq ASC ) AS rn FROM routine_file rf INNER JOIN files f ON rf.seqFile = f.seq ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rf ON r.seq = rf.seqRoutine WHERE r.seq = #{routineId}
